messages.subject: GCC Executive Profile | Mining, Energy, Sustainability & Country Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Kinetic Business Solutions Team,

I am sharing my profile for senior leadership mandates across Saudi Arabia, the UAE and the wider GCC. Kinetic's executive-search coverage across Energy & Sustainability, Mining and Natural Resources, Manufacturing & Industrial and corporate functions makes this a strong fit with my background.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My portfolio spans government and regulatory relations, ESG and sustainability, external and corporate affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships, social performance and executive advisory within a major gold-mining operation.

I am targeting Director, Senior Director, Head, Country Director or Representative, Executive Director and VP-track appointments. My strongest fit is where mining, natural resources, energy transition and industrial operations intersect with government relations, ESG, strategic partnerships and country-facing leadership.

I am internationally mobile, open to expatriate and residential assignments, and available on 30 days' notice. My current GCC-focused executive CV is attached for consideration across suitable current or confidential searches.

Preferred reply address: ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
